entry.title: Your Voice Assistant Can Be Social-Engineered Too, and Nobody's Watching For It
entry.summary: We spent a decade teaching people not to click the phishing link. Now we've built agents that will happily take instructions from whatever's playing in the background, and we haven't even started teaching them not to. entry.title: VLMs can score well on benchmarks, while silently erasing meaningful terms and including hallucinate bias [P]
